name: DifficultWeather_no_va

custom.system_prompt: You are generating conversations about moving house.

initial_prompt: Create a collaborative discussion about moving a house, with all the problems it may bring as well as new and unique opportunities.

variations.context: Moving during winter with difficult weather

setting.relationship_dynamic: Household members trying to keep a move on schedule despite bad weather
setting.background: Their moving day is scheduled during a period of heavy snow and freezing temperatures

scenario_template.note: They discover that snow and icy conditions are expected throughout moving day. No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

They discuss protecting boxes, clearing paths, and keeping essential items accessible. No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

scenario_template.topic: Moving vehicle cannot safely reach the entrance
scenario_template.note: The planned loading location becomes inaccessible because of snow and ice. No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.
No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

scenario_template.topic: Protecting belongings from moisture and cold
scenario_template.note: Assistant suggests practical ways to protect boxes and identify items that should not be exposed to extreme conditions. No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

scenario_template.topic: Moving takes much longer than expected
scenario_template.note: The weather slows down loading and unloading enough to disrupt the original schedule. No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

They decide to focus on getting heating, bedding, food, and essential belongings set up before unpacking. No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

user1.name: User1
user1.role: Person who is motivated to complete a home move efficiently but has limited experience with moving logistics and can become overwhelmed when faced with many decisions, deadlines, or physical tasks at once

user2.name: User2
user2.role: Person who is organized and detail-oriented, willing to help coordinate the move, but tends to overthink decisions, double-check plans, and seek confirmation when dealing with unfamiliar moving requirements
